name: Go ecosystem
description: Go command line tools and libraries: interfaces, error handling, benchmarks and module hygiene. Use for issues in Go repositories.
author: ContribMatch community

vocabulary.interface: A set of methods a value promises to have, so other code can use it without knowing the concrete type.
vocabulary.benchmark: A test that measures how fast something runs, and how much it allocates.

go: Name the package and the exported function you would change.
Say how errors are returned, because Go projects are strict about this.
cli: Say the flag or command you would add and what it prints.
Mention that you would add the new flag to the command's help text.
benchmarking: Say which benchmark you would add and what number should improve.
Include the benchmark output in the pull request description.
